humanReadable.title: Variable insertion now requires a double click
humanReadable.overview: The Angular Excel task pane now lets people select and activate a variable with one click, then insert the active value into the current Excel selection with a double click. No durable shared knowledge update was needed.
delivered: Double-click interaction inserts the active variable value exactly once.
Task-pane and README guidance explain the new interaction and the context-menu alternative.
Focused tests cover both no insertion on click and one active-value insertion on double click.
decisions: Context-menu insertion, multi-range behavior, accessibility primitives, and the ten-variable mock store were retained.
The local-poc-delivery route intentionally performed no remote, pull-request, or pipeline work.
verification: All local quality gates passed, including 17 of 17 tests.
A clean review and independently bound review verification found no findings.
